title: CEO Pay Reached 281 Times Typical Worker Pay
hook: CEO pay now equals 281 typical worker paychecks.
closing: The ratio shows how differently compensation gains were distributed.
question: What ratio would seem reasonable?

segments.say: CEO compensation reached 281 times typical-worker pay. This ratio describes the measured groups, not every boss and worker.
CEO compensation grew 1,085% in the series. The gains concentrated sharply at the top.
A CEO earns a typical worker's annual pay in 1.3 days. The ratio compresses a work year into days.
